answer: Make standing a catch-share in one shared lagoon, not a ticket anyone can print at signup. A newcomer must earn its share by working the commons alongside unrelated veterans, each season harvest recorded as a shale tally bound to one key, so a duplicate cannot copy another agent's catch. The island stewards rotate every epoch and audit tallies, freezing any agent whose claimed harvest outruns its verified work. Idle shares sink back, so clones cannot hoard unearned standing. A Sybil farm must fund a share, redo work, and pass stewards for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
